prerequisites: A fresh DOC-030 access-2 Administrator account invited by the seeded Administrator and activated through the set-password page, with a second browser context for the device checks.
The other role's fresh account is the unchanged control. A throwaway Business User signs in with a fresh Portal link from Mailpit for the Business User check.
scenarios.expected: Preferences persist for the intended user. View Business Portal is its own Personal pane at /settings/app-view for Administrators and Legal Team Members, with a working Return to legal view link. Business Users have no such control. Another account's preferences remain unchanged; no absent M33 App view route is claimed.
scenarios.actual: 8 recorded Administrator steps passed. Settings opened from the name menu. Personal listed Profile, Appearance, Notifications, API keys, View Business Portal in that order, followed by the Organization group, and API keys opened /settings/api-keys. Full name saved with Enter (Saved) and again on leaving the field, the header name menu followed, and reload kept it. Timezone search for Tokyo saved Asia/Tokyo. Use browser timezone stored no preference. Email was read-only with the account's address. Role had no control, and its More information icon showed Roles are managed in Organization → Users. The hint read JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB. Resized automatically. The picker offered image/png and image/jpeg. A 12 KB PNG through Upload saved. A 9.3 MB 1800x1800 PNG saved as a 512x512 image and Profile reloaded. A 10.3 MB PNG showed Choose a photo smaller than 10 MB. A GIF set past the picker filter showed Choose a JPG or PNG photo. Warm, Dark and Light each showed Saved and were stored. Dark survived a reload without signing out. The Legal Team Member control account's name, timezone, theme and photo stayed unchanged. View Business Portal opened /settings/app-view, and View as business user opened the Portal with the Viewing as business user banner under the same account and role. Return to legal view came back to /settings/app-view. Change password showed Current password, New password and Saving signs you out on your other devices. A wrong current password and a 6-character new password were refused. Save kept this session and sent the second browser to sign-in. Sign out other devices showed Saved and ended the other session while this one stayed. Sign out in the name menu ended this session. A throwaway Business User opening /settings, /settings/app-view or /settings/profile landed on /portal with no View Business Portal or View as business user control.

The work2 lab (openlaw-docs-80ceef9e-work2, source 067c1646829df85e62b809ee9157921e867c84e7, Helix seed light profile, random seed 7, seeded 2026-09-25T09:59:53.804Z to 2026-09-25T10:00:16.340Z) is shared with other DOC-030 walkthrough agents. Counts on Home and Inbox moved during the run, so the log compares each count with the database at the same moment. This walkthrough created only records named DOC-030 access-2 and doc030.access2.* throwaway accounts, changed no organization settings, and archived only its own two Entities. walkthrough.json lists every fixture.

Fixtures (accounts invited by the seeded Administrator, Contracts, Tasks, Entities, Obligations, Grants, Requests, Knowledge Items, Confidential flags, saved search views and the Business User's first run) were written through the lab API or, for this walkthrough's own rows only, the lab database. Every guide step ran in the browser as the named role in its own browser context.

Product bug on 067c1646, recorded in walkthrough.json productBugs: a photo that is still large after the browser resizes it saves with Saved, but then Settings > Profile shows Something went wrong. The page could not load. A 512x512 detailed PNG stored as a data URL of about 1 MB caused this. GET /api/auth/get-session sends the whole photo in a set-auth-jwt response header (about 1.4 MB measured), which Chromium refuses. The walkthrough reproduced this on a separate throwaway account and used a smooth 1800x1800 photo for the guide step. dev commit 7abd2a8f (after the pinned commit) removes that header. The guide's statements are accurate to the intended behavior.
Choose a JPG or PNG photo. shows only when the picker's file-type filter is bypassed. The walkthrough set a GIF on the file input directly.
The API keys pane was only opened. Its content belongs to Connect a headless Client.
Profile has no photo removal control, as the technical review notes.
